# TanBase Core

TanBase Core is an open-source TanStack Start application foundation for
Cloudflare Workers.

## Canonical resources

- Production origin: https://core.tanbase.dev/
- Source repository: https://github.com/tanfust/tanbase-core
- Public overview: https://github.com/tanfust/tanbase-core/blob/main/README.md
- Architecture: https://github.com/tanfust/tanbase-core/blob/main/docs/OVERVIEW.md
- Feature roadmap: https://github.com/tanfust/tanbase-core/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md
- Current status: https://github.com/tanfust/tanbase-core/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md
- Deployment runbook: https://github.com/tanfust/tanbase-core/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md
- Agent discovery: https://github.com/tanfust/tanbase-core/blob/main/docs/AGENT_DISCOVERY.md

## Current capabilities

The implemented foundation provides server-rendered React, static assets,
environment-specific Worker builds, observability, a public health check, CI,
and production deployment automation. The production site also runs a personal
task board with verified email and password accounts, protected by Cloudflare
Turnstile and per-IP rate limits, and private file attachments stored in R2.

## For agents

- MCP server: https://core.tanbase.dev/mcp (Streamable HTTP) lists, creates,
  and completes the signed-in person's tasks. Clients authorize with OAuth 2.1
  through TanBase Core's own authorization server,
  https://core.tanbase.dev/api/auth, using Dynamic Client Registration. The
  person signs in and approves the client; there are no API keys.
- Protected resource metadata: https://core.tanbase.dev/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp
- MCP server card: https://core.tanbase.dev/mcp/server-card
- Skill: https://core.tanbase.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/tanbase-tasks/SKILL.md,
  listed in https://core.tanbase.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- API catalog: https://core.tanbase.dev/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agentic resource catalog: https://core.tanbase.dev/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- In the browser, pages register the same task tools through WebMCP.
- Requesting the homepage with `Accept: text/markdown` returns it as Markdown.

## Capabilities not currently offered

TanBase Core does not offer a public REST API, API keys, agent registration
without a person signing in, an A2A agent, or payments. The public sitemap,
robots policy, and discovery documents describe only implemented resources.

Production deployment is not verified until the canonical URL passes the
repository smoke checks and that evidence is recorded in the status snapshot.
